When it is present in quantities greater than 10mg/kg it is required to be listed as an ingredient of the jam. Why is sulfur dioxide added to jam?

options.A: It is a bleaching agent and removes the undesirable colours from the fruit used in the jam.
options.B: It is a preservative that destroys unwanted bacteria and enzymes.
options.C: It is a reducing agent and removes the acids that give the jam a sharp taste.
options.D: It is an acidic gas and maintains the pH of the jam at a suitable value to give it a sharp taste.
